title: Independent distribution computations
html:
Independent distribution computations

Calculate entity gain and owner basis under the stated simplified rules.

Required responses

metadata.taxLawPeriod: 2026; exercise-specific rates and limits are stated in each case

fields.label: Outside basis after cash in the nonliquidating case
Property basis in the nonliquidating case
fields.explanation: Carryover basis is limited to $25,000 available outside basis.

fields.label: Asset basis in the liquidation case

exhibits.title: Corporate distribution
exhibits.html: Property basis $60,000; value $100,000; no liabilities. The ordinary corporate gain-recognition rule applies.

exhibits.title: Partnership cases
exhibits.html: Nonliquidating: outside basis $35,000; cash $10,000; property carryover basis $40,000 limited to remaining outside basis. Separate complete liquidation: outside basis $80,000; cash $20,000; one capital asset receives the remaining outside basis. No special exceptions apply.

explanation:
Corporate gain

$100,000 value − $60,000 basis = $40,000.

Outside basis after cash in the nonliquidating case

$35,000 − $10,000 = $25,000.

Property basis in the nonliquidating case

Carryover basis is limited to $25,000 available outside basis.

Asset basis in the liquidation case

$80,000 outside basis − $20,000 cash = $60,000.
